notes: More of the ways people ask for the sound to change now work. "Ramp up the volume", "knock up the audio", "wind the sound down" and a couple of dozen other phrasings used to reach nothing at all, while the same words in a different order worked fine — some verbs had been wired for louder but not quieter, or the other way round. They all work now, in both directions and either word order, and asking about the picture still changes the picture: "turn the brightness up" is still a colour change, not a volume one.
